verdicts.reason: A is mostly the original layout with wide side margins added. It keeps the hierarchy and reading order, but the circle shape now sits behind the 'Saturday 21 June' text block, there is a large dead band below the CTA, and the whole stack is pinned to a narrow centre column instead of using the square canvas. B is jumbled. The RSVP CTA has shrunk into a pill among the badges and looks like one of them. 'Solstice Presents' has moved below the event details, the tagline, URL and date/time lines are crammed together and misaligned, and the phone dominates as a competing focal point.
